sample_rule.selected_by: research agents working from written briefs, on 2026-09-30, before any classification ran
sample_rule.rule: US companies with a dated public signal of a .NET, Azure, Power Platform or Dynamics initiative, taken from sources other than job boards: Microsoft customer stories, partner case studies, press releases, leadership-change announcements, the company's own careers or service pages. One brief asked for end customers, one for hard cases (companies that describe themselves as IT solutions or consulting firms, IT staffing firms, Microsoft partners, mixed businesses), one for leadership changes and careers pages. One company appearing in two briefs was kept once; one company was added by hand to reach 50.
sample_rule.not_a_client_list: Public sample selected by me, not a client-provided list.
sample_rule.frozen: The 50 rows, the research prompt and the decision policy were fixed before the benchmark run started in Clay.

models.research: Clay Argon, web research (fixed 3 data credits per row)

whole_workspace_so_far.note: Everything spent in the workspace on 2026-09-30: building and testing the table, one review pass that ran on every row before its run condition was saved, one accidental research rerun, and the five fixtures.

price_basis.usd_per_action_source: Growth plan, 40K actions/mo for $205/mo, clay.com/pricing read 2026-09-30

usage.external_spend: none: the quote checker runs on Cloudflare Workers free tier; no model API was called outside Clay
